03. 1.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual /Physical Mode).
2.
This interlocutory application has been filed by the Petitioners seeking modification of order dated 27.09.2023 passed by this Court in the aforesaid bail application.

3. Learned counsel for the Petitioners submitted that the F.I.R. on the basis of which the bail application has been filed has been downloaded from the CCTNS Website of Odisha Police wherein Bolangir Town P.S. No.0421 registered on 16.08.2023 furnishes information that the alleged offences have been committed under Section 420/34 of I.P.C. whereas the F.I.R. which was filed in the trial court by the police pertaining to the very same police station, i.e. Bolangir Town P.S. Case No.0421 dated 16.08.2023 reveals that offence is under Sections 406/34 of I.P.C.
4.
In view of the aforesaid discrepancies, the prayer for modification is allowed.
5. Accordingly, the offences under Sections 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code as mentioned in paragraph-3 of order dated 27.09.2023 be read as "Section 406/34 of the I.P.C.".
